messages:
Anya (CS): quick flag from Syncoria onboarding today — three repeat asks from finance, security, and mobile devs. could be a renewal blocker. tagging @Ravi @Connor

Ravi (Product): please paste the asks + any verbatim phrasing. rough prioritization ok.

Anya (CS): short list: (1) in-Console per-route & environment cost lines (currently export-only); (2) endpoint-level variant lockdown so security can block experimental weights on PHI endpoints; (3) mobile SDK: resume + exponential backoff to avoid full stream restarts.

Connor (PM): my take: 3 is high ROI (reliability fix, quick), 1 is medium (backend + UI), 2 is larger (RBAC + audit + legal) so lower near-term.

Marta (AE): renewal date 2025-09-01. Syncoria said procurement needs per-route visibility before final approval.

Anya (CS): sample quotes from calls:

Anya (CS): ```
Syncoria,per_route_visibility,procurement needs line items,"We have to show cost per workflow to allocate budgets"
Syncoria,variant_lockdown,security must limit models,"We can't risk experimental variants on patient flows"
Syncoria,mobile_reconnect,devs need resume,"When LTE drops the session restarts and loses context"
```

summarizer-bot: tags created [cost_visibility, variant_lockdown, mobile_reconnect]. linked PROD-Triage-1201.

Connor (PM): I'll open PROD-Triage-1201 and propose priorities: mobile_reconnect -> P1, per_route_visibility -> P2, variant_lockdown -> P3. will add estimates after scoping.

Ravi (Product): add to roadmapsync and request one-paragraph customer brief + invoice sample before we scope.

Anya (CS): action items: Anya collect invoice rows + quotes; Connor open ticket; Ravi review legal if needed; Marta prep renewal note for CSM. looping back with artifacts. :thumbsup:
